domain-name.name: domain-name
domain-name.help: MS Exchange server fully qualified domain name.

username.name: username
username.help: User name used to sign in to the server. Must have proper permissions for service.

connect-protocol.name: connect-protocol
connect-protocol.help: Connection protocol used to connect to MS Exchange service.

options.name: rpc-over-tcp
options.help: Connect using RPC-over-TCP. Use for MS Exchange 2010 and earlier versions. Supported in MS Exchange 2013.

options.name: rpc-over-http
options.help: Connect using RPC-over-HTTP. Use for MS Exchange 2016 and later versions. Supported in MS Exchange 2013.

options.name: rpc-over-https
options.help: Connect using RPC-over-HTTPS. Use for MS Exchange 2016 and later versions. Supported in MS Exchange 2013.

auth-type.name: auth-type
auth-type.help: Authentication security type used for the RPC protocol layer.

auth-level.name: auth-level
auth-level.help: Authentication security level used for the RPC protocol layer.

http-auth-type.name: http-auth-type
http-auth-type.help: Authentication security type used for the HTTP transport.

ssl-min-proto-version.name: ssl-min-proto-version
ssl-min-proto-version.help: Minimum SSL/TLS protocol version for HTTPS transport (default is to follow system global setting).

auto-discover-kdc.name: auto-discover-kdc
auto-discover-kdc.help: Enable/disable automatic discovery of KDC IP addresses.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable automatic discovery of KDC IP addresses.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable automatic discovery of KDC IP addresses.

kdc-ip.name: kdc-ip
kdc-ip.help: KDC IPv4 addresses for Kerberos authentication.

ipv4.name: ipv4
ipv4.help: KDC IPv4 addresses for Kerberos authentication.
